name: Fashion Sense v7.5.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Added `NotEqualTo` comparison type.
* Added `IsMoving` condition.
* Added `DrawOrderOverride` support for animations, allowing specific frames to override the layer they are rendered on.
* Added "Simple Pants Template" to better match the game's existing pants layout.
* Adjusted `HideWhileWearingBathingSuit` to override bathing skin if false for shirts, pants or shoes.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Floogen/FashionSense/compare/v7.4.0...v7.5.0

name: Fashion Sense v6.7.0
body:
**Changelog:**
* Implemented `AppearanceModel.Item`, which allows for in-game items to be associated with a Fashion Sense appearance. [See this page for details](https://github.com/Floogen/FashionSense/wiki/Item-Properties).
* Added mannequin support for saving and swapping outfits. Outfits can be saved by left-clicking an empty mannequin with the Hand Mirror. The mannequin's outfit can be copied by right-clicking with a Hand Mirror.
* Added config options for quickly opening the Fashion Sense menu, with an option to require the Hand Mirror to be in the inventory. The shortcut key must be assigned in order to use it.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Floogen/FashionSense/compare/v6.6.0...v6.7.0

name: Fashion Sense v6.0.0
body:
**Changelog:**
* Updated to Stardew Valley v1.6.
* Implemented `AppearanceModel.HidePlayerBase`.
* Implemented outfit exporting and importing, allowing users to share outfits with one another.
* Implemented outfit presets, allowing content pack authors to create premade outfits for users.
* Implemented Tags property for appearances.
* Implemented `AnimationModel.Offset`.
* Added `GameStateQuery` condition.
* Updated outfits to display which appearances are missing from outfits.
* Updated pants template based on changes from violetlizabet.
* Fixed color layers not being labelled correctly for shoes.
* Fixed sleeves template using incorrect frame during scythe animation.
* Fixed custom sleeves not utilizing `ColorMaskLayers`.

name: Fashion Sense v6.0.0-alpha.6
body:
**Changelog:**
* Added outfit exporting / importing, allowing users to share their outfits with others.
* Added outfit presets, allowing content pack authors to share premade outfits via `preset_outfits.json`.
* Added the `Tags` property, allowing content pack authors to make their appearances easier to search for.
* Added the `GameStateQuery` condition.
* Added filters to the appearance search menu, allowing for searches against the appearance name, pack name and tags.
* Updated the outfit list to show any missing appearances when hovering over an outfit.
* Updated the clear button to clear all equipped appearances, when holding shift.
* Fixed sleeves template using incorrect frame during scythe animation.
* Fixed custom sleeves not utilizing `ColorMaskLayer`.
* Fixed crash when setting `DrawOrderOverride.AppearanceType` to `Hat`.
* Fixed accessories not respecting multiple layers when restoring outfits.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Floogen/FashionSense/compare/v6.0.0-alpha.5...v6.0.0-alpha.6
